stories.title: Tier Configuration & Auto-Upgrade on Points Threshold
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want to be automatically upgraded to a higher tier when my lifetime points cross the threshold, so that I immediately enjoy better rewards
acceptance_criteria: Given tiers are configured (Bronze 0-999, Silver 1000-4999, Gold 5000-19999, Platinum 20000+), When my lifetime points cross a tier threshold, Then my tier is immediately upgraded and the new tier is reflected on my dashboard within 2 seconds
Given I am upgraded to a new tier, When the upgrade occurs, Then I receive a push notification: 'Congratulations! You've reached {tier} status!'
Given my tier is upgraded, When my earn rate is calculated on the Dunelm purchase, Then the new tier multiplier is applied (Silver 1.25x, Gold 1.5x, Platinum 2x)
Given the tier upgrade notification, When read by a screen reader, Then it announces the tier name and new benefits clearly

requirements_used: FR-26 — Loyalty Tier System — configurable tiers, auto-upgrade, configurable benefits

stories.reasoning: 5 points: tier evaluation logic + multiplier application + notification + real-time display. Immediate upgrade provides instant gratification driving engagement.

stories.title: Annual Tier Downgrade Review with Warning
stories.user_story: As Nathan (loyalty customer), I want to be warned before a tier downgrade and given time to maintain my status, so that I don't lose benefits unexpectedly
acceptance_criteria: Given the annual review date is approaching, When I haven't maintained my tier threshold in the trailing 12 months, Then I receive a notification 30 days before: 'Your {current_tier} status is at risk. Earn {points_needed} more points by {date} to keep your benefits.'
Given 7 days remain before downgrade, When I still haven't met the threshold, Then I receive an urgent notification: 'Last chance! {points_needed} points needed by {date} to keep {tier} status.'

Given the annual review date arrives, When I haven't maintained the threshold, Then my tier is downgraded by one level and I'm notified: 'Your tier has changed to {new_tier}. Keep earning to upgrade again!'
Given I earn enough points before the review date, When the threshold is met, Then no downgrade occurs and I receive: 'Great news! You've maintained your {tier} status for another year.'

requirements_used: FR-26 — Loyalty Tier System — annual downgrade, configurable review date

stories.reasoning: 5 points: batch job + 30-day/7-day warning logic + downgrade execution + positive path (maintained). Two-stage warning gives customers time to act, reducing churn.

stories.title: Tier Progress Display on Dashboard
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want to see my progress toward the Dunelm tier on my dashboard, so that I'm motivated to keep earning
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I view my dashboard, Then I see a progress bar showing my current lifetime points relative to the Dunelm tier threshold with label: '{current_points} / {Dunelm_threshold} points to {Dunelm_tier}'
Given I am at the highest tier (Platinum), When I view the progress bar, Then it shows 'Platinum — You're at the top!' with a full progress bar
Given the progress bar, When navigated by screen reader, Then it announces current tier, points earned, points needed, and Dunelm tier name

requirements_used: FR-26 — Loyalty Tier System — tier displayed on dashboard

stories.reasoning: 3 points: progress bar UI + edge case (max tier) + accessibility. Visual progress is a key engagement driver. Accessibility AC for user-facing component.

stories.title: Early Access Notification for Qualifying Tier Members
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer) with Gold tier, I want to be notified about exclusive early access to sales, so that I can shop before the general public
acceptance_criteria: Given a promotion is created with early_access: true and qualifying_tier: 'Gold', When the early_access_start time arrives, Then all Gold and Platinum members receive a notification: 'Exclusive early access! As a {tier} member, you can shop the {sale_name} {hours} hours before everyone else.'
Given I am a Silver or Bronze member, When the early access period is active, Then I do not receive the early access notification
Given the notification is delivered, When I tap it, Then I am deep-linked to the sale page within the app

requirements_used: FR-12 — Loyalty Tier-Based Early Access — qualifying tiers, notification, configurable window

stories.reasoning: 3 points: scheduled notification + tier filtering + deep link. Tier-based exclusivity drives upgrades. Negative path (non-qualifying) ensures no false notifications.

stories.title: Early Access Enforcement — Tier-Gated Sale Pages
stories.user_story: As a platform engineer, I want sale pages to enforce tier-based access during the early access window, so that only qualifying members can shop early
acceptance_criteria: Given a sale has early_access: true and the current time is within the early access window, When a Gold or Platinum member accesses the sale page, Then they see the full sale content and can add items to cart

Given the early access window is active, When a Bronze or Silver member accesses the sale URL, Then they see: 'This sale opens for all members on {date}. Upgrade to {qualifying_tier} for early access!'
Given the early access window has ended, When any member accesses the sale page, Then they see the full sale content regardless of tier
Given the access-denied message, When read by a screen reader, Then it announces the restriction reason and the general access date

requirements_used: FR-12 — Loyalty Tier-Based Early Access — access control during window

stories.reasoning: 3 points: access control middleware + time-window logic + messaging. Enforcement at API level prevents URL sharing circumvention. Accessibility AC for user-facing denial message.

stories.title: Create & Activate Promotional Bonus Campaign
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want to create time-bound promotional campaigns that award bonus points, so that I can drive engagement during key periods without engineering involvement
acceptance_criteria: Given I am in the admin portal campaign section, When I create a campaign with: name, type (multiplier/fixed_bonus/category_bonus), value, start_date, end_date, eligibility_rules, and optional max_budget, Then it is saved in 'draft' status
Given a draft campaign exists, When I activate it and the start_date arrives, Then it becomes 'active' and eligible transactions begin receiving bonus points
Given an active multiplier campaign (2x), When a qualifying customer makes a purchase earning 100 base points, Then they receive 200 total points (100 base + 100 bonus) with separate ledger entries
Given an active fixed_bonus campaign (+50 points), When a qualifying customer makes a purchase, Then they receive their base points plus 50 bonus points as a separate ledger entry with campaign_id

requirements_used: FR-24 — Promotional Bonus Campaigns — time-bound, eligibility rules, multiplier or fixed bonus

stories.reasoning: 5 points: campaign CRUD + activation logic + bonus calculation integrated with accrual engine. Separate ledger entries enable campaign ROI analysis.

stories.title: Campaign Eligibility Rules & Budget Cap
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want to set eligibility rules and budget caps on campaigns, so that I can target specific segments and control liability
acceptance_criteria: Given a campaign with eligibility 'tier_minimum: Gold', When a Silver member makes a purchase, Then no bonus is applied and only base points are earned
Given a campaign with eligibility 'new_members_only' (registered within 30 days), When an existing member makes a purchase, Then no bonus is applied
Given a campaign with max_budget of 50,000 points, When total bonus awarded reaches 50,000, Then the campaign auto-pauses with status 'budget_exhausted' and no further bonuses are awarded
Given a campaign is paused or its end_date passes, When a qualifying purchase occurs, Then no bonus is applied

requirements_used: FR-24 — Promotional Bonus Campaigns — eligibility rules, budget control

stories.reasoning: 5 points: eligibility evaluation engine + budget tracking + auto-pause. Budget cap prevents runaway liability. Multiple negative paths ensure non-qualifying transactions are handled correctly.

stories.title: Customer-Facing Campaign Banner
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want to see active promotions I'm eligible for on my dashboard, so that I'm motivated to make purchases during campaign periods
acceptance_criteria: Given active campaigns exist that I'm eligible for, When I view my dashboard, Then a promotional banner carousel shows each campaign with: name, benefit description ('Earn 2x points this weekend!'), and end date
Given no active campaigns exist for my eligibility, When I view my dashboard, Then the promotional banner section is hidden (not an empty state)
Given the campaign banner, When navigated by screen reader, Then each campaign is announced with its name, benefit, and expiry date

requirements_used: FR-24 — Promotional Bonus Campaigns — customer-facing visibility

stories.reasoning: 3 points: banner carousel UI + eligibility filtering + empty state handling. Visibility drives campaign participation. Accessibility AC for user-facing component.

stories.title: Admin Portal — Dashboard & Authentication
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want a secure admin portal with a dashboard showing key loyalty metrics, so that I can monitor program health at a glance
acceptance_criteria: Given I navigate to the admin portal, When I authenticate via SSO with MFA, Then I am granted access based on my role (admin/marketing/support)
Given I am authenticated, When the dashboard loads, Then I see: active members count, sign-ups this month, redemption rate %, and total points liability
Given I am not authenticated or my session has expired, When I access any admin page, Then I am redirected to the SSO login page
Given the admin portal login, When a user without an admin/marketing/support role attempts access, Then they receive 'Access Denied — contact your administrator'
Given any admin action is performed, When it completes, Then it is logged to the system audit trail with actor_id and action details

requirements_used: FR-25 — Admin Portal — configure rates, manage tiers, create promotions, view analytics

stories.reasoning: 5 points: SSO + MFA + dashboard metrics + RBAC + audit logging. Restricted because admin portal provides access to all customer data. Security AC for authentication and authorization.

stories.title: Admin Portal — Tier & Rules Configuration
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want to configure tier thresholds, multipliers, and redemption rules from the admin portal, so that I can adjust the program without engineering deployments
acceptance_criteria: Given I am in the Tier Management section, When I edit a tier's threshold or multiplier and save, Then the change takes effect immediately for all future transactions
Given I am in the Rules Configuration section, When I update accrual_rate, redemption_rate, min_redemption, or max_discount_percentage, Then the new values are applied to all subsequent transactions
Given I change a configuration value, When the save completes, Then the before and after values are logged to the audit trail with my admin user ID
Given I attempt to set an invalid value (e.g., negative multiplier, threshold lower than a lower tier), When I submit, Then inline validation prevents the save with a specific error message

requirements_used: FR-25 — Admin Portal — configure rates, manage tiers

stories.reasoning: 5 points: CRUD UI for tiers + rules config + validation + audit. Restricted because configuration changes affect all customers' financial outcomes. Security AC via audit logging.

stories.title: Admin Portal — Customer Lookup & History
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want to search for customers and view their full loyalty history, so that I can investigate issues and support escalations
acceptance_criteria: Given I am in the Customer Lookup section, When I search by phone, email, name, or loyalty ID, Then matching customers are displayed with: name, tier, balance, and member since date
Given I select a customer from results, When their detail page loads, Then I see: full profile, current tier, points balance, lifetime points, and complete transaction history (paginated)
Given I am viewing a customer, When I click 'Trigger Adjustment', Then I am taken to the manual adjustment form pre-filled with the customer's ID
Given customer search results contain PII, When displayed, Then email and phone are partially masked (e.g., j***@email.com, ***-***-1234) unless the admin explicitly clicks 'Reveal'

requirements_used: FR-25 — Admin Portal — view analytics, customer management

stories.reasoning: 5 points: search + detail view + pagination + PII masking. Restricted because full customer data access. Security AC for PII masking follows data minimization principle.

stories.title: Admin Portal — Reports & CSV Export
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want to export sign-up, transaction, and campaign performance reports as CSV, so that I can analyze data in external tools
acceptance_criteria: Given I am in the Reports section, When I select a report type (sign-ups, transactions, campaign performance) and date range, Then the report is generated and available for download as CSV within 30 seconds for up to 50,000 records
Given I export a transactions report, When the CSV is generated, Then it includes: date, customer_id (not PII), transaction_type, points, channel, and campaign_id (if applicable)
Given I am a user with 'marketing' role, When I attempt to export reports containing full PII, Then the export is blocked with: 'PII export requires admin role approval'

requirements_used: FR-25 — Admin Portal — export reports

stories.reasoning: 3 points: report generation + CSV export + role-based PII restriction. Restricted because exports could contain sensitive aggregate data. Security AC prevents marketing role from exporting raw PII.

stories.title: Admin Portal — Audit Log Viewer
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want to view the system audit log from the admin portal, so that I can investigate changes and verify compliance
acceptance_criteria: Given I am in the Audit Log section with 'admin' or 'compliance' role, When I apply filters (customer_id, action type, date range, actor), Then matching audit entries are displayed in a paginated table sorted by timestamp descending
Given I am a user with 'marketing' role, When I access the Audit Log section, Then I see only my own actions (not full system audit)
Given an audit entry is displayed, When I expand it, Then I see the full before_state and after_state JSON with syntax highlighting

requirements_used: FR-25 — Admin Portal — view audit logs

stories.reasoning: 3 points: read-only viewer + filtering + role-scoped access. Restricted because audit logs contain full operational history. Security AC limits marketing role to own actions only.

stories.title: App Sign-Up Bonus Points Award
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want to receive bonus points when I register via the mobile app, so that I'm rewarded for downloading and joining through the app
acceptance_criteria: Given I complete registration via the mobile app (channel: 'app'), When my account becomes active, Then I am immediately credited with the configured bonus points (default: 200) as a ledger entry with type 'bonus' and reason 'app_signup'
Given I receive the sign-up bonus, When I view my dashboard for the first time, Then a celebration animation plays with message: 'Welcome! You've earned 200 bonus points for joining via the app!'
Given I receive the sign-up bonus, When a push notification is sent, Then it reads: 'Welcome! You've earned {points} bonus points for joining via the app!'
Given the celebration animation, When viewed by a user with reduced motion preferences, Then the animation is replaced with a static congratulations card

requirements_used: FR-09 — App Sign-Up Bonus Points — configurable amount, one-time per customer, credited immediately on app registration

stories.reasoning: 3 points: event listener + ledger write + celebration UI + notification. Accessibility AC for reduced motion. App-only restriction drives the 15K downloads/month KPI.

stories.title: App Sign-Up Bonus — One-Time Enforcement & Channel Restriction
stories.user_story: As a platform engineer, I want the app sign-up bonus to be awarded only once per customer and only for app registrations, so that the bonus cannot be exploited
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer has already received the app_signup bonus (flag set in customer record), When they attempt to trigger it again (e.g., re-install and re-login), Then no additional bonus is awarded
Given a customer registers via the website (channel: 'web'), When their account becomes active, Then no sign-up bonus is awarded
Given a customer registers via in-store assisted mode (channel: 'pos'), When their account becomes active, Then no sign-up bonus is awarded
Given the bonus amount is changed in admin portal from 200 to 300, When the Dunelm app registration occurs, Then the new amount (300) is awarded

requirements_used: FR-09 — App Sign-Up Bonus Points — one-time per customer, app channel only, configurable amount

stories.reasoning: 3 points: one-time flag check + channel validation + admin configurability. Negative path story preventing abuse. Multiple channels tested to ensure exclusivity.

stories.title: Campaign Performance Dashboard for Admin
stories.user_story: As a Marketing Manager (admin), I want to see campaign performance metrics in the admin portal, so that I can evaluate ROI and decide whether to extend or pause campaigns
acceptance_criteria: Given I am in the Campaign Management section, When I view an active campaign, Then I see: total bonus points awarded, number of qualifying transactions, budget remaining (if set), and unique customers reached
Given a campaign has ended, When I view its performance, Then I see final metrics plus a comparison to the same period without the campaign (baseline transactions)
Given I am viewing an active campaign, When I click 'Pause', Then the campaign status changes to 'paused' immediately and no further bonuses are awarded

requirements_used: FR-24 — Promotional Bonus Campaigns — campaign management and performance visibility

stories.reasoning: 3 points: metrics aggregation + pause action + baseline comparison. Enables data-driven campaign decisions without engineering involvement.

stories.title: Admin Portal — Unauthorized Access Attempt Handling
stories.user_story: As a security engineer, I want unauthorized access attempts to the admin portal to be blocked and logged, so that potential breaches are detected early
acceptance_criteria: Given a user without any admin role attempts to access the admin portal URL, When the request is processed, Then they receive a 403 page with no information about the portal's existence and the attempt is logged with IP, user agent, and timestamp
Given 5 failed authentication attempts from the same IP within 10 minutes, When the 6th attempt occurs, Then the IP is temporarily blocked for 30 minutes and a security alert is raised

Given a valid admin user's session token is used from a different IP than the authentication IP, When the request is processed, Then it is flagged for review and the user is prompted to re-authenticate

requirements_used: FR-25 — Admin Portal
NFR-07 — API Rate Limiting and Abuse Prevention

stories.reasoning: 3 points: brute-force protection + IP blocking + session anomaly detection. Negative path story for security hardening. Restricted because it involves security controls for the admin portal.

stories.title: Tier Multiplier Not Applied When Tier Engine Unavailable
stories.user_story: As a platform engineer, I want points accrual to proceed with base rate when the tier engine is unavailable, so that customers aren't blocked from earning points during outages
acceptance_criteria: Given the tier service is unavailable or times out (> 2 seconds), When a points accrual is processed, Then base rate (1x) is applied and the transaction is flagged for 'tier_bonus_pending'
Given flagged transactions exist, When the tier service recovers, Then a reconciliation job calculates and credits the missed tier bonus within 1 hour
Given a reconciliation bonus is credited, When the customer is notified, Then they receive: 'Bonus points added: {points} tier bonus for your recent purchase.'

requirements_used: FR-26 — Loyalty Tier System
NFR-05 — 99.9% Uptime with Failover

stories.reasoning: 3 points: circuit breaker + flagging + reconciliation job. Negative path ensuring tier service failure doesn't block core accrual. Graceful degradation pattern.

regression_summary.recommendation: Greenfield — no regression testing needed. All stories are new capabilities.
